facts.text: Languages spoken here include German, French and Dutch.
It is a coastal country in Western Europe.

culture.text: Belgian comic-book culture has a strong presence in Brussels, including shops devoted to comics and their characters.

food.name: Moules-frites
food.text: Mussels served with fries; white wine, onions and celery are common additions to the cooking pot.
